verdict.rationale: gstack is a skill and methodology pack for AI coding agents, so asking whether it can consume tools from MCP servers is a fair question. However, no evidence item mentions MCP or registering external tool servers. Its browser daemon, skills and host configs are its own features, and any MCP client support would belong to the host agents (e.g., Claude Code), not to gstack itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
